project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo: Vite React SPA (frontend), AWS Lambda backend, shared domain types, AWS CDK infra. Issue #17 is a FRONTEND-ONLY UX change.
build_system: npm workspaces. Node/npm may NOT be on PATH - prefix commands with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (confirmed working this session; fallback /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin).
test_framework: Vitest colocated as *.test.ts(x) in each workspace; frontend uses jsdom + @testing-library/react (see frontend/src/test/setup.ts). Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts, headless chromium (--no-sandbox). fast-check *.property.test.ts for pure invariants.
build_command: npm run build  (ordered shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra)
test_command: npm test  (runs vitest across all workspaces). E2E: npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend. Synth regression guard: npm run synth.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build must pass. 2) npm test must pass (add unit tests for relative-time helper EN/JA and the auto-refresh polling hook with fake timers). 3) npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (may need `npx playwright install chromium` once). 4) npm run synth as a regression guard. NO cdk deploy, NO live Bedrock/MLB calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in that this change touches. Vite emits frontend/dist (gitignored); cdk synth emits cdk.out (not committed).
setup_instructions: Node 22 toolchain already present. Dependencies already installed (node_modules present, baseline build+test green at session start). Playwright chromium may need `npx playwright install chromium -w @mlb/frontend` before first e2e run.
environment_constraints: Network mode not explicitly checked; dependencies already installed so no registry access needed. Do NOT push, open PRs, deploy, or make live AWS/MLB/Bedrock calls. Stay on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site with incremental commits.
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always and MANDATORY: (a) incremental commits per feature; (b) all new user-facing strings localized EN+JA via frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (MessageKey union + both MESSAGES tables); (c) spec-driven dev is graded - update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design}.md and BOTH README.md and README.ja.md truthfully; (d) tests added in the same change as behavior; keep build/test/synth green.
key_patterns: HomePage.tsx holds bracket state as a discriminated union BracketState (loading|error|ready) and selectedSeriesId local state; a useEffect keyed on [season] does the initial getBracket() load with a `cancelled` guard. api.getBracket(season) returns {bracket, usedFallback} and falls back to the bundled seed offline. Season predictability comes from @mlb/shared isPredictable(season) (CURRENT_YEAR=2026). In-progress series = series.status === 'in_progress'. Bracket.updatedAt is an ISO string. i18n: useI18n() -> {lang,setLang,t}; t(key, params) interpolates {param}; MessageKey is a string-literal union, both 'en' and 'ja' tables must stay in sync. SeriesDetailPage also fetches a bracket but is for FINISHED series only and is OUT OF SCOPE for polling.
